historyRetention.title: History retention
historyRetention.description: How much of your transcripts and recordings stays on this machine. Starred entries are never removed by “Latest 20”. Switching to “Latest 20” removes older unstarred entries right away. “Keep forever” keeps transcripts forever but only the latest 100 recordings (recordings on starred entries and failed transcriptions are kept). “Stop keeping from now on” means new transcripts and recordings are not kept. Entries already saved stay where they are — use “Delete all” in History to remove them. Failed recordings are not kept either, so there is no way to re-transcribe and recover them later.
